blocks.text: Diesel fuel system tune-up notes, September 8

This is the working cut for RDW-MTG-2022-024 on September 8, 2022. Hank Morel asked for a written bound after the current path (One filter, crank, hope) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Shop Helper, writing for Cal Dreher, Nina Soto, and Hank Morel. Primary host bay-03.ridgeway.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on crank until it catches after a filter, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

Replace both filters as a pair. Prime. No long crank. Air in fuel is a leak, not a 'needs more cranking.' I am not restating a hallway yes. crank until it catches after a filter is out because August 30 starter cooked after 28 seconds of crank. Filter was dry. Prime is 90 seconds of work. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: seconds=28, prime=90, filters=2, weeks=2, starter=1, air=1, pair=1, hope=0. Sibling tickets RDW-2344 and RDW-SOP-2022-011. I will not reopen crank until it catches after a filter in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Nina Soto is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.
